pages.text: $(l)Spiritual Roots$() are a cultivator's innate talent, determining cultivation speed, technique power, and cultivation path. Use $(l)Root Test Stone$() to check your root attributes.

pages.title: Root Attributes
pages.text: Five elemental roots correspond to five elements:$(li)$(l)Metal Root$(): Metal technique power +30%$(li)$(l)Wood Root$(): Wood technique power +30%$(li)$(l)Water Root$(): Water technique power +30%$(li)$(l)Fire Root$(): Fire technique power +30%$(li)$(l)Earth Root$(): Earth technique power +30%$(br2)Rare variant roots include $(l)Thunder/Ice/Wind$().

pages.title: Root Count
pages.text: Root count affects cultivation speed:$(li)$(l)Single Root$() (Heavenly Root): 200% speed, extremely rare$(li)$(l)Dual Root$(): 150% speed, quite excellent$(li)$(l)Triple Root$(): 100% speed, average quality$(li)$(l)Quad Root$(): 70% speed, poor quality$(li)$(l)Penta Root$() (False Root): 50% speed, difficult to cultivate$(br2)Fewer roots = purer talent = faster cultivation.

pages.title: Root Purity
pages.text: Besides count, each root has a $(l)purity value$():$(li)Purity 90-100: Supreme root$(li)Purity 70-89: High-grade root$(li)Purity 50-69: Middle-grade root$(li)Purity 30-49: Low-grade root$(li)Purity 10-29: Inferior root$(br2)Purity affects that element's technique power and cultivation efficiency for that attribute's manuals.

pages.title: Special Physiques
pages.text: Some cultivators have innate $(l)special physiques$(), stronger than normal roots:$(li)$(l)Thunder Spirit Body$(): Thunder technique power x2, tribulation resistance +50%$(li)$(l)Ice Spirit Body$(): Ice technique power x2, cold poison immunity$(li)$(l)Fire Spirit Body$(): Fire technique power x2, fire damage halved$(li)$(l)True Spirit Body$(): All attributes +20%, breakthrough success +10%$(br2)Special physiques are extremely rare (~0.1-1%) but highly advantageous.

pages.title: Roots & Manuals
pages.text: Manuals usually have root requirements:$(li)$(l)Metal Manuals$(): Metal root +50% cultivation speed$(li)$(l)Compound Manuals$(): Require two or more roots$(li)$(l)Neutral Manuals$(): Any root can cultivate$(li)$(l)Special Manuals$(): Require specific physique or variant root$(br2)Choosing manuals matching your roots yields better results.

pages.title: Root Improvement
pages.text: Roots can be improved through special methods:$(li)Take $(l)Marrow Cleansing Pills$() to boost purity$(li)Small chance to optimize roots when breaking through with Foundation Pills$(li)Special realm opportunities can change root attributes$(li)High-tier manual cultivation slowly improves root quality$(br2)Note: Marrow Cleansing Pills are extremely rare, usually found only in high-tier realms or sect treasuries.

pages.title: Root Strategy
pages.text: Choose development path based on roots:$(li)$(l)Single Root$(): Specialize in corresponding element manuals, aim for high realms$(li)$(l)Dual Root$(): Cultivate compound manuals, balanced development$(li)$(l)Triple Root+$(): Choose neutral manuals or life skill path$(li)$(l)Special Physique$(): Find physique-exclusive manuals for maximum advantage$(br2)Roots aren't everything—manuals, pills, and opportunities matter equally.
